hints.content: A relative minimum point is a point that is lower than all other graph points around it. It's like the lowest point on a "valley."

The graph has three relative minimum points in the given section. One at $(-5,1)$, one at $(1,-5)$, and one at $(5,-2)$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A function is made up of line segments. A line segment connects negative eight, three to negative five, one. A line segment connects negative five, one to zero, four. A line segment connects zero, four to one, negative five. A line segment connects one, negative five to three, three. A line segment connects three, three to five, negative two. A line segment connects five, negative two to eight, three.
